claimTicketMetaphor.principle: Russian has a ready claim-ticket ritual: the cloakroom «номерок» (you hand it in at the «гардероб» and get your coat back) and the «квитанция» you show at a pickup counter. Use it in prose. Printed labels stay short and ticket-like, the way Russian tickets print «КОНТРОЛЬ» on the tear-off part.
claimTicketMetaphor.ticket: «билет» on printed labels; «номерок» in metaphor copy (Ссылка — ваш номерок, файл — то, что вы забираете)
claimTicketMetaphor.stub: «корешок» or «отрывной талон»; the stub button can carry the label «КОНТРОЛЬ» as decoration, with the real action text «Скачать»

grammarNotes: Pinterest is used two ways. Formal/editorial: Latin, undeclined ('с Pinterest'). Search: Cyrillic, declined ('с пинтереста', 'из пинтереста') or undeclined ('с пинтерест'). Titles use 'Пинтереста' (or 'Пинтерест' where autocomplete drops the case); H1, body and legal lines use 'Pinterest'.
пин is masculine: 1 пин, 2 пина, 5 пинов; use Intl.PluralRules("ru") (one/few/many/other) for every counter, e.g. «Найдено 21 пин», «24 пина», «25 пинов».
Imperative, polite «вы» form for instructions (Скопируйте, Вставьте, Нажмите). Lowercase «вы» except in direct personal letters.
Quote UI labels in «ёлочки»; nested quotes „лапки“. Arrows for paths: «Поделиться» → «Скопировать ссылку».
ё: search engines treat ё = е; use ё consistently in body copy (ещё, всё), and it is optional in titles.

formats.numbers: Decimal comma (2,5 МБ); thousands separated by a no-break space (U+00A0) or narrow no-break space (U+202F): 12 345. Use Intl.NumberFormat("ru-RU").
formats.resolution: Keep as 720p, 1080p (Latin p, no space). Never write «1 080p».
formats.fileSize: Б, КБ, МБ, ГБ with a no-break space: «3,4 МБ». Intl unit formatting gives «3,4 МБ» with style "short".
formats.dates: 15.10.2026 (numeric) or «15 октября 2026 г.» (long). Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU"). Never MM/DD.
formats.durations: «1:24» for media length; «2 мин 5 с» in prose.
formats.percent: «50 %» per GOST, or «50%» (common on the web); pick one. No real stats exist to display anyway.
formats.currency: Not needed (free product). Never show prices.
formats.pluralRules: one (1, 21, 31…), few (2–4, 22–24…), many (0, 5–20, 25–30…), other (fractions). Every count string needs 3 forms.
formats.dashes: Em dash with spaces « — » (no-break space before it). Hyphen only inside words (Telegram-бот, ZIP-архив).
formats.nbsp: No-break space after one-letter and short prepositions/conjunctions (в, с, к, и, о, на, по) and before em dashes, so they never dangle at a line end.

typography.displayFontCyrillicSupport: Big Shoulders Display has NO Cyrillic. The self-hosted woff2 (public/fonts/big-shoulders-display-latin-900-normal.woff2) has 230 glyphs, 0 in U+0400–04FF, and no № (U+2116). Upstream Google Fonts/Fontsource also lists only latin, latin-ext and vietnamese (api.fontsource.org/v1/fonts/big-shoulders-display). Russian headlines will fall back to Arial Narrow (desktop Windows/macOS only) or the regular-width system sans at 900 weight on phones. That loses the condensed gothic and makes H1s 30-40% wider.
typography.recommendation: Add a Cyrillic condensed gothic for :lang(ru). Candidates with Cyrillic and 800/900 weights (Fontsource): 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed' (cyrillic, cyrillic-ext; 100–900), the closest in spirit; 'Fira Sans Extra Condensed' (cyrillic; 100–900); 'Roboto Condensed' (cyrillic; 100–900); 'Oswald' (cyrillic; max 700). Set it for the whole headline on ru pages, not via unicode-range glyph mixing: a mixed Latin/Cyrillic headline like «СКАЧАТЬ ВИДЕО С PINTEREST» would visibly switch faces mid-line. Self-host only the cyrillic + latin subsets and preload one weight.
typography.lengthExpansion: Russian runs about 10–25% longer than English in running text, and Cyrillic caps (Ж, Ш, Щ, Ы, Ю, М, Д) are wider than Latin caps. The H1s here are kept at 19–42 chars, close to the English H1s (Pinterest Video Downloader = 26; How to Download Pinterest Video in Gallery = 42). Test the two longest at 360px: «КАК СКАЧАТЬ ВИДЕО С PINTEREST НА КОМПЬЮТЕР» (42) and «КАК СОХРАНИТЬ ВИДЕО С PINTEREST В ГАЛЕРЕЮ» (41).
typography.hyphenation: No hyphens: auto on uppercase display headlines (it breaks words like КОМПЬЮ-ТЕР mid-gothic). For body text, lang="ru" + hyphens: auto is fine. Long single words to watch in narrow chips/buttons: «Предпросмотр», «изображения», «аватарку», «Скачивание».
typography.uppercase: text-transform: uppercase works for Cyrillic (ё → Ё). Keep 0.04–0.08em tracking on labels; Cyrillic caps need no extra tracking.
typography.diacritics: Only ё/Ё (and й). Make sure the chosen face has Ё with its dots at 900 weight.
typography.numeroSign: № is required for the serial («№ 1120271…»); verify the glyph in the Cyrillic face.

risks: CLOUDFLARE THROTTLING IN RUSSIA: pintdownload.app is served by Cloudflare (response header server: cloudflare). Since 9 June 2025 Russian ISPs have throttled Cloudflare-fronted sites to the first ~16 KB of each asset, and Cloudflare said it cannot fix this (blog.cloudflare.com 'russian-internet-users-are-unable-to-access-the-open-internet'; zona.media 2025-06-27; 3dnews 2025-06-27). I found no 2026 source saying it was lifted. If it is still in force, Russian visitors, and possibly YandexBot crawling from Russia, see a broken page, and the ru pages cannot rank in Yandex. check-host.net RU data-centre nodes returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-14, which says nothing about consumer-ISP throttling. Verify before investing: Yandex Webmaster «Проверка ответа сервера» and a real RU residential connection. KZ/BY are unaffected.
VPN LAW: Russian law has banned advertising ways to bypass blocks (incl. VPN) since 1 March 2024. Russian copy must never suggest a VPN, even in troubleshooting FAQs.
PINTEREST STATUS IN RUSSIA: not blocked but repeatedly fined (Taganka court 6 mln RUB, Dec 2025; further fines reported Sep 2026). A future block would cut RU demand (KZ/BY unaffected). Monitor.
Personal-data localisation (152-FZ/242-FZ) targets operators collecting Russian users' personal data. PintDownload has no accounts; if analytics or ads cookies are added, review before targeting RU.
